# MENAARC

> Architectural consultancy in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Design and project
> management for retail, food and beverage, hospitality and residential
> projects across the Emirates. Founded by Ar. Rashid Ahamed.

MENAARC takes projects from first sketch through authority approval and onto
site. Design and delivery are run by the same studio on the same programme,
rather than handed between separate teams.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.menaarc.com/): Scroll-controlled architectural film and studio overview.
- [Work](https://www.menaarc.com/work): Completed projects, filterable by sector.
- [Studio](https://www.menaarc.com/studio): How the practice is structured, and who runs it.
- [Services](https://www.menaarc.com/services): Design and project management capabilities in detail.
- [Contact](https://www.menaarc.com/contact): Enquiries.

## Services

- Design: concept and schematic design, design development, interior architecture, detailed drawings and specification, material and finishes schedules, 3D visualisation.
- Project management: programme and cost planning, tendering and contractor selection, authority approvals and NOCs, site supervision and snagging, MEP and specialist coordination, handover and close-out.
